title: CYBERPUNKT is a gritty pixel-art loot-action RPG (built with free tools, play the whole game free)
author: ehartye
selftext:
**CYBERPUNKT** is a gritty pixel-art loot-action RPG that runs right in your browser. Fight up through eight neon-soaked districts of a megacity, from the rain-slick Sprawl Row to the Zenith Spire, where the city's mind, Omni-Prime, waits. Play as a Chrome Ronin, Netrunner, Psion or Deadeye, chase loot that glows with rarity beams and legendary powers, and drop psychedelic chems that melt the screen around you. Every sprite, sound and track was built by AI agents, and it plays with a keyboard, a controller or your thumbs.

Play it free here: [https://ehartye.github.io/cyberpunkt](https://ehartye.github.io/cyberpunkt)

Built using these free tools:

[https://github.com/ehartye/agent-engine](https://github.com/ehartye/agent-engine)

[https://github.com/ehartye/agent-sprites](https://github.com/ehartye/agent-sprites)

[https://github.com/ehartye/agent-beeps](https://github.com/ehartye/agent-beeps)
